title: D12 native Companion: client families in one boot
description: DRAFT SKELETON (lane staging; not in the product tree). One reserved iOS simulator, one launch of the development dev client, and one deliberate cold restart, against a private gateway and store proxy from the D12 controller. Phases in order: online fill, reconnect, offline cold start, new-epoch recovery. The run-list-version-fill steps are placeholders until the D12 code and its app observer exist. Each command runs scripts/agentic/prove-d12-native.mjs (to be written), which prints one JSON receipt per phase and asks the controller for checkpoints (change runs, fail one artifact read, stop or start the gateway) through request files, as in D11.

proofTargets.claim: PLACEHOLDER (D12 code): the cold fill stores the version index and filter projection of every live run and full rows up to the bound; after K runs change, a reconnect and the new-epoch catch-up read only changed and missing ids; offline totals come from the projections.
After the app's socket closes it reconnects by itself, and a mounted evidence image whose first read failed online shows after the reconnect without a reload.

After prefetch and a cold restart with the gateway stopped, the pending gate opens with its details and evidence images loaded and verified, its run Diff screen renders the package diff, both sides are held, and the app sends no gateway frame.
The runner model catalog read online is restored offline after the cold restart with the same model ids.
Upstream data read online (PRs, saved GitHub accounts, runner seats) is restored offline with its original times and recovers on a new gateway epoch.

online.intent: Wait until the app is connected and prefetch holds the gate package.

assert-online.intent: Require a connected receipt with the gate package held by prefetch.

run-list-fill.intent: PLACEHOLDER (D12): read the cold fill from the app observer.

assert-run-list-fill.intent: PLACEHOLDER (D12): every live run has a version and a projection.

catalog-online.intent: Record the model ids the app read from the fake runner catalogs.

assert-catalog-online.intent: Require a nonempty catalog read online.

upstream-online.intent: Open the PR screen online and record its rows and their times.

reconnect.intent: Change K runs, fail one image read, then drop the socket once.

assert-reconnect.intent: Require the reconnect and the image recovery in the same screen.

assert-run-list-reconnect.intent: PLACEHOLDER (D12): the reconnect read exactly the K changed ids.

offline.intent: Stop the gateway and proxy, then make the one deliberate cold restart.

assert-offline.intent: Require a cold start with the gateway down and no gateway frame.

assert-run-list-offline.intent: PLACEHOLDER (D12): offline totals equal the live count, from the store alone.

gate-offline.intent: Open the pending gate offline; check its details and images.

gate-screen.intent: The gate review screen renders offline.

assert-gate-review.intent: Require loaded, verified images and held both sides, no frames.

gate-diff-offline.intent: Open the gate run's Diff screen offline and wait for its package diff.

diff-screen.intent: The run Diff screen renders offline.

assert-gate-offline.intent: Require the review, the rendered diff and no gateway frame.

catalog-offline.intent: Compare the restored catalog with the online read.

assert-catalog-offline.intent: Require the same model ids offline.

upstream-offline.intent: Open the PR screen offline and compare it with the online read.

assert-upstream-offline.intent: Require the same rows with their original times offline.

recover.intent: Start the gateway on a new epoch and wait for the app to recover.

assert-recover.intent: Require upstream recovery on the new epoch.

assert-run-list-catch-up.intent: PLACEHOLDER (D12): the new-epoch catch-up read exactly the K2 changed ids.
